content.title: Collector Device Hero Film | Whole, Detail Inspection and Front Return
content.summary: A field console is proven through front, port, vent and seam evidence before a hero return. Preserve the five causal invariants and terminal proof while replacing all source-specific surfaces.

quick_start.input_format: One original product design remains continuous. + The complete product precedes all detail proof. + Every macro view reconnects to registered geometry. + Lighting reveals material without changing shape. + The final hero frame uses only original branding.
quick_start.recommended_input: Present one original amber-and-slate field console complete on a black plinth. Inspect one side port, rear vent and copper seam in three registered macro views. Return to the opening front angle and hold the exact original name AURORA FIELD for two beats.
required_anchors: One original product design remains continuous.
The complete product precedes all detail proof.
Lighting reveals material without changing shape.
The final hero frame uses only original branding.
usage_steps: Replace the example subject, setting, and surface details with an original concept.
Keep every required anchor and Creative DNA invariant causally visible.
Choose the MiniMax H3 or Seedance 2.0 prompt and fill only the declared variable slots.
Check duration, event order, camera continuity, sound, and anti-copy constraints before generation.
applicable_scope: A field console is proven through front, port, vent and seam evidence before a hero return. Preserve the five causal invariants and terminal proof while replacing all source-specific surfaces.
Original 4–15 second concepts that can preserve every required anchor.
MiniMax H3 or Seedance 2.0 projects that need a reusable causal video structure.
not_suitable_for: Requests that copy the source identity, setting, props, dialogue, or shot order.
Concepts that cannot show all required anchors inside the target duration.
Long-form exposition or unrelated multi-location stories without a compact causal chain.

creative_dna.mechanism: 先以完整收藏设备建立结果，再用背面、接口、控制件和材质微距逐项证明设计；运镜始终围绕同一产品，最终回到完整正面英雄构图。 The reusable mechanism preserves causal order, spatial anchors and the final proof while replacing every source-specific person, location, object, wording, choreography and design.

invariants.rule: One original product design remains continuous.
invariants.purpose: Establishes the baseline identity, object or geography that every later state must preserve.
invariants.ablation_failure: Without this exact baseline rule, later changes cannot be attributed to the same subject, object or place, so the sequence loses its reference state. Removed rule: "One original product design remains continuous."

invariants.rule: The complete product precedes all detail proof.
invariants.purpose: Makes the visible trigger precede and explain the first mechanism response.
invariants.ablation_failure: Without this exact trigger rule, the response appears spontaneously and the central cause-and-effect claim is no longer demonstrated. Removed rule: "The complete product precedes all detail proof."

invariants.rule: Every macro view reconnects to registered geometry.
invariants.purpose: Keeps the middle progression registered instead of allowing an unexplained reset.
invariants.ablation_failure: Without this exact progression rule, the middle can jump to a replacement state and the accumulated result is no longer traceable. Removed rule: "Every macro view reconnects to registered geometry."

invariants.rule: Lighting reveals material without changing shape.
invariants.purpose: Reconnects the changed or partial state to the established subject and spatial anchor.
invariants.ablation_failure: Without this exact reconnection rule, detail or transformed shots can belong to a different subject or geography and continuity cannot be verified. Removed rule: "Lighting reveals material without changing shape."

invariants.rule: The final hero frame uses only original branding.
invariants.purpose: Turns the terminal hold into observable proof that the mechanism completed.
invariants.ablation_failure: Without this exact terminal-proof rule, the sequence stops on motion alone and never confirms the promised outcome or preserved aftermath. Removed rule: "The final hero frame uses only original branding."

slots.name: lead_subject
slots.constraint: An original stable subject or pair with a readable role.

slots.name: setting
slots.constraint: A new setting with fixed spatial anchors and no source-specific surface.

slots.name: escalation_variable
slots.constraint: One causal variable that changes through visible stages.

slots.name: performance_rule
slots.constraint: A restrained acting or motion rule that keeps the mechanism legible.

slots.name: camera_grammar
slots.constraint: An information order that proves each state without copying source shot boundaries.

slots.name: payoff
slots.constraint: A clean final physical, informational or social consequence.

slots.name: sound_family
slots.constraint: An original hierarchy of diegetic cues; no unsupported source-audio claim.

anti_copy_exclusions: all source faces, bodies, wardrobe, identities and creator-specific character designs
the source location, set dressing, props, products and exact environmental geometry
all source words, logos, watermarks, typefaces and brand identifiers
the source choreography, exact camera path, shot durations and transition timing
the source palette, signature effects, prompt wording, creator handle and narrative particulars
